admission.justification: The router, manifest, both taskless role openings and Orientation carry the same boundary. Mistaking the shared Projects execution workspace for a registered repository or inventing a provider incident would create or investigate work without a selected scope; these exact mistaken inferences are explicitly prohibited by the inspected current sources.

applicability: Manual native Projects launches explicitly selecting Architect or Investigator without canonical task references, including an earlier system-specialist spelling read as Investigator.
conditions: The developer request is the scope source.
Only actually missing outcome/repository or concern/report scope is asked for; an Investigator concern may be of any kind.
exclusions: Task-bound selections, which retain their supplied canonical task and paired enclosure.
Other taskless foundation/bootstrap admissions described by their own contracts; this statement does not expand the native launcher role set.
Projects is an execution workspace and never, by itself, a registered repository identity.
Generated skill mirrors are synchronized outputs, not separate semantic declarations.

evidence: Frozen Ctree 83aa7103dca3c104e58df155baead24f10be784f: SKILL.md:14-16; composition-manifest.json:29-36; roles/architect.md:8; roles/system-specialist.md:8; operations/orientation.md:3. No live taskless run or fresh test result is claimed.

statement: An explicitly selected taskless Architect or Investigator at Projects uses the supplied developer request and asks only for missing outcome and registered repository, or missing concern and report scope; it creates no inferred repository, sprint, master or task identity. Investigator concern scope is any kind, and the earlier system-specialist read spelling has that canonical meaning.
